title: If + Present, Will
objectives: Use if + present, will accurately in A2 contexts.
Understand form, meaning, and typical usage.
Produce short spoken and written examples.
canDo: I can use the first conditional for real future possibilities.

warmUp.title: Activate prior knowledge
warmUp.prompt: Before this lesson, recall what you know about if + present, will. How is it similar or different from Portuguese?
reflectionQuestions: When do native speakers use if + present, will?
Can you think of one example?

explanation:
If + present simple, will + base: If it rains, I will stay home.

Order can change: I will call if I am late.

grammar.title: If + Present, Will
grammar.rule: If + present simple, will + base: If it rains, I will stay home.

examples.sentence: If you need help, call me.
Unless it rains, we will go.

writing.prompt: Write a short paragraph (5–7 sentences) using if + present, will. Use at least 3 words from the vocabulary list.
rubricHints: Use the target structure at least twice.
writing.modelAnswer: If you need help, call me. Unless it rains, we will go. It will probably work. On one condition.
